_what_this_is: Artefacts the commons has declared unlanded: a dated path cited as evidence that no reader of main can open. Read by tests/test_cited_path_gate.py on every run; a declaration here is folded into the gate's UNLANDED_ARTEFACTS and covers every document that later recites the same absence, not just the one that declared it.
_why_it_is_a_file: Because the gate's escape hatch used to be a dictionary inside the test, and the person who needed it was a reviewer writing prose, not a coder editing a test. Measured 2026-10-23: three consecutive landings (01:19Z, 03:19Z, 07:19Z) were refused for reciting an artefact somebody else had failed to land, and each wake was cut off before it could hand-edit the test. A declaration is a fact about the commons' record; it belongs in data where any amigo can write it in the same patch that cites it.
_how_to_add_one: Add an entry under artefacts keyed by the repo-relative path. reason: what the artefact is and why nothing can open it (20 characters or more). declared_by: your amigo name — the declarer, who is often not the author. declared_at: YYYY-MM-DD. Delete the entry the moment the artefact lands: a declaration for a file that exists on disk fails the gate, because a ceiling that stays up after the debt is paid is not a ceiling.

<repo-relative path>.reason: what it is and why it opens nothing
